name: CashyAi
shortDescription: Track spending, split bills with friends, and ask an on-device AI before you spend — private by design.
description: CashyAi is an Android expense tracker that helps you log income and spending, plan savings goals, split bills with friends, and get bill reminders. A local, on-device AI (no cloud calls for your financial data) answers questions like "Can I afford this?" using your own transaction history. An optional Google Drive backup keeps a copy of your data in a private folder tied to your account, so you can restore it on a new device.

screenshots.alt: CashyAi dashboard showing monthly cash flow, income, expenses, and upcoming bills
CashyAi on-device AI chat answering a spending-safety question
CashyAi split expenses screen showing balances owed between friends

features: Expense, income, and bill tracking with reminders
Split expenses with friends and a running contact ledger
Savings goals and a safe-to-spend daily limit
On-device AI chat for spending questions — no financial data leaves the device
PDF and CSV export of your own records
Optional Google Drive backup and restore

googleSignIn.purpose: CashyAi uses Google Sign-In for exactly one feature: backing up your app data to your own Google Drive and restoring it later, for example after switching devices. Sign-in is optional — the app is fully usable without it, and no Google account is required to track expenses, split bills, or use the AI chat.

scopes.reason: Shown in Settings so you can see which Google account a backup is signed in with. Not used for advertising, analytics, or any purpose beyond identifying the signed-in account.

Lets the app read and write only its own hidden application-data folder in your Drive — the same folder other apps' Drive backups cannot see. CashyAi cannot see, list, or modify any other file in your Google Drive with this scope.

googleSignIn.dataNotAccessed: CashyAi never requests access to your Gmail, contacts, calendar, general Drive files, or any other Google data.

sidebar.title: Financial data stays on your device.
sidebar.body: CashyAi's AI features run entirely on-device. Google Sign-In is optional and used only for Drive backup.

name: Wend
shortDescription: Log injections, protein, weight and symptoms on your GLP-1 medication — a calm, private journal to bring to your next appointment.
description: Wend is a companion journal for people taking GLP-1 medication. Log each injection and site, weight, food and protein, water and symptoms, and see a smoothed weight trend instead of daily noise. Keep your prescriber's dose plan, track medication costs and refills, and export a summary for your next appointment. Premium adds AI meal estimates from a photo, a weekly strength plan to help protect muscle, and the doctor-visit summary. Wend is not a medical device and never recommends doses.

features: Injection log with dose, site rotation and a countdown to your next dose
Protein, water, food and symptom tracking with severity
Smoothed weight trend, weekly recap and badges for non-scale wins
Your prescriber's dose plan, medication cost and refill tracking
AI meal estimates from a photo — 3 free scans, then Premium
Doctor-visit summary, data export and one-tap account deletion

googleSignIn.purpose: Wend uses Google Sign-In to create your account and sign you in. There are no Wend passwords. Your Google name pre-fills your first name during setup.

scopes.reason: Identifies your Wend account so your journal syncs securely to it. Your name and email are not shown to other members, and are not used for advertising or analytics.

googleSignIn.dataNotAccessed: Wend never requests access to your Gmail, Google Drive, contacts, calendar, or any other Google data.

sidebar.title: Your health journal stays private.
sidebar.body: Entries are private to your account, community posts are anonymous, and Wend has no ads or ad trackers. Export or delete everything from Settings.
